facts.text: Cincinnati Parks describes a paved wheelchair-accessible path leading to views of the preserve. Path gradients and dimensions are not supplied.
facts.quote: Bettman Nature Preserve also boasts a small nature preserve, and a paved wheelchair accessible path leading to views of the preserve.

facts.text: In a July 26, 2020 article, Cincinnati Parks described Bettman’s Sensory Garden and Pathway as having accessible walkways, an overlook, an accessible picnic table and raised planting beds. This is historical published information, not a current condition check.
quote: Bettman Sensory Garden and Pathway – Located in O’Bryonville, this historical outdoor space provides a series of accessible walkways, easy access to an overlook, an accessible picnic table and raised planting beds.

facts.text: The nature center page says the building is closed to the public and opens for programming only. The same page separately offers library/archive visits by appointment, with volunteer availability on Tuesdays, noon–3 p.m. These statements are not reconciled; call 513-321-6070 before planning an indoor visit.
facts.quote: The library and archives are open to the public by appointment; our volunteer staff is available on Tuesdays from noon to 3pm. For more information on Bettman Nature Center, please call 513-321-6070. Hours: Currently closed to the public. Open for programming only.

facts.text: The park feature list includes public restrooms at the nature center, but the same page restricts public entry to the building. Restroom availability outside programs and access features remain unconfirmed; call before relying on them.
quote: Public Restrooms at Nature Center
Hours: Currently closed to the public. Open for programming only.

facts.text: The park page lists outdoor hours as dawn to dusk. This does not override the separate restrictions on entering the nature-center building.
facts.quote: HOURS Open dawn to dusk

facts.text: The current city listing gives 1.5 miles of nature trail, 0.75 mile of paved trail and about 2.5 miles using sidewalks and roads. These published segment figures do not establish a continuous paved route.
facts.quote: Covington's trail includes 1.5 miles of nature trail, .75 miles of paved trails, and approximately 2.5 miles of trail utilizing sidewalk and road infrastructure.

facts.text: Trail access points are behind Holmes High School at Levassor and Eastern avenues, at the dead end of East 16th Street, at Clayton-Meyer Park, and behind Randolph Park.
facts.quote: Trail access can be found behind Holmes High School at the corner of Levassor and Eastern Ave. Additional locations to access the trail include the dead end of E. 16th Street, Clayton-Meyer Park and behind Randolph Park.

facts.text: The city’s September 2019 completion article describes parallel upper-levee paved trail (about 0.75 mile) and lower riverside gravel nature trail (about 1.5 miles). It calls the whole Greenway 2.5 miles including sidewalks/roads. Confirm distance and surface before choosing a route.
quote: Most of that stretch includes parallel trails – about 0.75 miles of paved trail atop the levee and about 1.5 miles of a gravel “nature trail” that cuts through a narrow stretch of woods along the river’s edge.
All told, the LRGT is 2.5 miles long, including sidewalk and road infrastructure.

facts.text: The city’s current Trails overview describes a 2½-mile hiking route from Levassor Place to Randolph Park, with a parallel paved trail for only part of the way. Confirm which route segment meets your needs.
facts.quote: 2½-mile-long hiking trail along the Licking River from Levassor Place to Randolph Park. A parallel paved trail runs part of the way.

facts.text: The city’s September 2019 report says a pedestrian bridge installed in May 2018 carried the paved path over 16th Street at the floodwall opening. This is historical route information; current bridge and approach conditions are unverified.
facts.quote: On May 18, 2018, for example, Dudley Construction supplied a critical link to two parts of the Greenway, installing a metal pedestrian bridge to carry the paved path over 16 th Street at the cut in the floodwall that leads to the campus of painting contractor Rizzo Brothers Inc.

facts.text: The branch lists a calming room and a fine-motor, arts-and-crafts area. Room availability and individual sensory conditions need confirmation.
quote: CALMING ROOM
FINE MOTOR AND ARTS AND CRAFTS AREA

facts.text: The gym lists swings, crash mats, a zip line, trampoline and climbing structure. This does not establish wheelchair access onto equipment or transfer assistance.
quote: SUSPENDED EQUIPMENT WITH SWINGS
CRASH MATS AND CRASH PILLOWS
ZIP LINE
TRAMPOLINE
INDOOR PLAY STRUCTURE

facts.text: During open play, a parent or guardian must stay with the child at all times.
facts.quote: A PARENT OR GUARDIAN MUST ACCOMPANY THE CHILD DURING OPEN PLAY AT ALL TIMES.

facts.text: The open-play page prohibits shoes on the gym floor and requires socks for adults and children. Ask the branch about any footwear support you need.
facts.quote: No Shoes are allowed on the gym floor. Socks are required for all adults and children.

facts.text: Open-play hours change with private rentals and parties. Call 859-727-9787 or check the current weekly schedule before travelling.
quote: Hours vary based on private rentals and birthday party reservations. Please check our appointment calendar above or call for more information.
PLEASE CALL OR CHECK SOCIAL MEDIA FOR THIS WEEK'S OPEN PLAY SCHEDULE

facts.text: The private-rental/play-date offer is weekdays only, for up to 10 people, with one adult guest for every four children and booking two weeks ahead. These are the private-rental terms; field-trip supervision is different.
quote: Weekdays only . Up to 10 people, with one adult guest required for every 4 children.
Must be booked two weeks advance.

facts.text: Private rentals include the gym, art room and calming room, but no childcare. The party room is excluded, and private rentals/play dates cannot be used as birthday packages.
quote: Includes use of gym, art room, and calming room.
Childcare is not included with private rentals. Party room is not included in private rentals and private facility rental/playdates cannot be used as birthday packages.

facts.text: For school field trips, the branch offers shoe covers for purchase for adults unable to remove shoes and says it can accommodate children with leg braces or sensory issues. Arrange the needed accommodation; this contract does not establish the open-play exception.
facts.quote: We have shoe covers available for purchase for adults who are unable to remove their shoes and can make accommodations for children with leg braces and sensory issues.

facts.text: School field trips require at least one non-staff adult for every three children. Gym staff help with the experience but are not in charge of the children’s care.
facts.quote: ADULT SUPERVISION: We require that there is at least 1 adult (non-staff member) for every 3 children on your field trip. Our staff is here to help provide our guests with a fun and safe experience, but are not in charge of the children's care.

facts.text: The school field-trip form invites requests such as no music or hiding lobby snacks. A request is not confirmation that a particular arrangement will be provided.
facts.quote: If you have any requests, such as 'No Music', 'Hide lobby snack', or anything else you would like us to be aware of please let us know above.

facts.text: The public field-trip option is limited to groups of 10 or fewer students, excludes Fridays and shares the gym with open play. A private field trip closes the gym to the public.
quote: Public (This option is only available for groups with 10 or less students. This option is not available for Fridays. The gym will be open to the public for Open Play.
Private (the gym will be closed to the public.

facts.text: For field trips, food and drinks must stay in the party room or lobby, outside the gym area.
facts.quote: FOOD & DRINKS: All food and drinks must remain in our party room or lobby, not the gym area.

facts.text: The care page advertises respite, break-time and one-to-one attendant care but also says “Services Coming Soon!” Confirm whether care is currently offered; do not plan a drop-off based on the advertised service or prices.
quote: We offer Respite , Break Time Care , and One-to-One Attendant Care .
Services Coming Soon!

facts.text: For the care service whose availability remains unclear, the page specifies ages 3–13 and toilet-trained children, requires a parent conversion form and says the gym is not a licensed daycare. These restrictions are not stated as general open-play admission rules.
quote: Services Coming Soon!
For children ages 3 to 13 years. Children must be potty trained.
A parent conversion form is required for both levels of service.
We Rock the Spectrum is not a licensed daycare facility.

facts.text: The field-trip contract prohibits adult equipment use and says an adult riding the zipline will be asked to leave. Its combined adults/older-teens sentence also contains a disability-related exception whose scope is unclear. Confirm age eligibility and assistance arrangements before booking.
facts.quote: EQUIPMENT USAGE: No adults are permitted on equipment for safety reasons. Adults and older teens (unless they have special needs) are strictly forbidden to go on the zipline. If an adult goes down the zipline, they will be asked to leave the facility immediately.

facts.text: For school field trips, first-time visitors under 18, including infants, need a signed waiver before entering the gym floor. The branch offers a waiver file schools can distribute as an alternative to online registration.
facts.quote: WAIVERS: Any children (anyone under the age of 18, including infants) who have not been to our gym previously need to have signed liability waivers before entering the gym floor. Families can register children and agree to the liability forms at https://werockthespectrumnorthernkentucky.com/register. We can also send you a file with our waiver for you to distribute to your students if that works better.

address_quote: 331 Kenton Lands Rd - Suite 400, Erlanger, KY 41018

facts.text: The venue places its specialty tea room upstairs and describes traditional low-floor seating there. Confirm an appropriate seat and route before booking; the page does not explain a lift or step-free upstairs connection.
facts.quote: Upstairs, guests can discover our specialty tea room and traditional low-floor seating for an immersive experience.

facts.text: The ground floor has landscape and zodiac murals, and the café describes antique furnishings and décor throughout. This is visual-environment context, not a promise of low stimulation.
quote: Inside, the ground floor features a breathtaking mural by Adam Lusso, capturing the tranquility of Asian landscapes alongside the twelve zodiac animals.
Every corner of our café is filled with antique furnishings and décor, each piece carrying its own unique story and cultural charm.

facts.text: Published hours are Tuesday–Friday 7 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m., closed Mondays. Confirm holiday or event changes before travelling.
facts.quote: Operation Hours Monday​ Tuesday​ - Friday​ Saturday​ - Sunday​ Closed​ 7 AM-5 PM​​ 7:30 AM-5 PM​

facts.text: The official site locates Fei House at 640 Main Street in Covington. Older event descriptions on the same site still use the Kung Brew name.
quote: Fei House, 640 Main St, Covington, KY 41011, USA
Join us on the 2nd floor of Kung Brew

facts.text: Admission includes games set to free play and re-entry that day; visitors do not need quarters or tokens. The site says entry after 9 p.m. is adults only.
quote: We are a free play arcade. No quarters or tokens, just admission.
All games set to Free-play
Includes re-entry for the day
After 9pm we are adults only

facts.text: Children under 12 need a responsible adult aged 18 or older admitted and playing alongside them. Under-18s are welcome before 9 p.m.; ages 18–20 may attend throughout opening hours.
quote: Under 12 Require a responsible adult (18+) to be admitted and play alongside them Welcome before 9pm
12-17 Welcome before 9pm
18-20 Welcome during all open hours

facts.text: Membership entry requires the membership card and matching ID. Membership covers one person; no companion admission is specified.
quote: Unlimited admissions for one individual
Present your membership card with matching ID for entry

facts.text: The group-visit offer requires at least 10 people. The party offer adds exclusive use of the party room for two hours; its physical access is not described.
quote: Group Visit
Minimum 10 people
Exclusive access to Party Room for 2 hours

facts.text: For visit arrangements, call 513-389-0000 or email wondercadecincy@gmail.com. The listed schedule is Wednesday–Friday 4 p.m.–midnight, Saturday 2 p.m.–midnight and Sunday 2–9 p.m.
quote: wondercadecincy@gmail.com
Wednesday: 4pm - 12am Thursday: 4pm - 12am Friday: 4pm - 12am Saturday: 2pm - 12am Sunday: 2pm - 9pm

facts.text: Free interview and everyday clothing is offered to NKU students in University Center 142. Students must bring their All Card to shop.
quote: The Care Closet @ NKU offers free clothing to assist NKU students in finding appropriate interview wear and everyday needs. Visit our location University Center 142.
Students must have their All Card to shop with us.

facts.text: Students can arrange an appointment outside operating hours. Graduate and law students needing an appointment are directed to carecloset@nku.edu.
quote: Students can come to the Care Closet @ NKU during the open hours of operation or schedule an appointment with the Assistant Coordinator to visit the space outside of operating hours.
Are you a graduate or law student needing an appointment? Email us at carecloset@nku.edu

facts.text: The published hours panel is explicitly for Spring 2026: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, 11 a.m.–3 p.m., closed during on-campus events. Confirm this term’s hours before travelling.
facts.quote: Spring 2026 Hours UC 142 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday: 11am - 3pm *We will be closed during on-campus events

facts.text: There is no visit-frequency limit, but students are asked to take only what they need and bring a reusable bag.
quote: We no longer have a limit on how often you can visit the Care Closet @ NKU; however, we ask that you keep in mind that the CC is for everyone at NKU, so please only take what you need!
Please bring your own reusable bag!

facts.text: Students may collect items for other people if they tell the service. Children’s clothing is held at the Newport home base and must be requested for collection at NKU; it is not promised as NKU walk-in stock.
quote: Can I take items for other people? Yes! We just ask that you let us know so we can better understand who we are helping in the community.
We have all kinds of clothes for babies and children of all ages at our home base in Newport. Just complete our online form and we will pull a bag together and arrange to get it to you.
Email Amy Kees to request your items and ask to pick up these items at the Care Closet @ NKU.

facts.text: Clothing donations are not generally accepted at NKU. For a few suitable, clean items in good condition, email a list to carecloset@nku.edu and coordinate a drop-off time; do not assume walk-in donation service.
facts.quote: We do not generally accept clothing donations; however, if you believe that you have a few* items that will benefit our college students, are on-trend, and are clean, in good condition and free of tears or holes, you can email carecloset@nku.edu with a list of donation items. A drop-off time must be coordinated with the Care Closet.

facts.text: NKU links a campus map intended to identify accessible routes and building entrances. It is campus-level orientation and does not describe the indoor connection to Care Closet room UC 142.
facts.quote: The campus map is designed to indicate the most accessible routes and entrances to buildings on NKU's campus.

facts.text: For visitors using designated disability spaces, NKU requires both a state-issued disability placard and a Parking Services permit. Its Nunn Drive office lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; summer hours may vary. Confirm arrangements at 859-572-5505.
quote: Handicap spaces are available to visitors with ADA needs. These spaces require a valid state issued handicap placard and a permit issued by Parking Services.
Please stop by the Parking Services on Nunn Drive between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. to obtain a permit Monday-Thursday or 8:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. on Friday (summer hours may vary).
If you have specific visitor parking questions please call us at (859) 572-5505.

facts.text: Visitor garages are Arena, University and Kenton. Pull a ticket even if the gate is raised; payment accepts Visa, MasterCard or Discover. The 2026–27 table lists $12 for stays over four hours or a lost ticket. Departmental validation is possible but not promised for this service.
quote: Visitor parking is located in the Arena Garage, University Garage, and Kenton Garages
Always pull a ticket as you enter the garage, even if the gates are up.
Garages accept Visa, MasterCard, and Discover
Some departments validate parking, be sure to check with department prior to heading back to vehicle.
Garage Rates (26-27)
4.0 Hours + $12.00 Lost Ticket $12.00

facts.text: Surface lots require a permit. A visitor day permit can be bought online for $12, printed and displayed on the dashboard; it applies only to the registered vehicle in Student Parking or Permit Parking lots.
quote: All vehicles must possess a permit to park in surface lots.
Visitors can purchase a pass from the parking office or visitors can purchase a printable day permit online for $12/day.
The permit must be displayed on your dashboard and can only be used in the Student Parking or Permit Parking lots. The permit can only be used in the vehicle that was assigned to the permit.

facts.text: NKU’s September 16, 2026 facilities report places University Center passenger-elevator modernization in the planning phase, with anticipated completion in summer 2027. This is a dated project update, not a live outage or completion notice. Confirm elevator operation and the route to UC 142 before relying on it.
quote: September 16, 2026

University Center Passenger Elevator Modernization (AP) The passenger elevator in the University Center is at end-of-life and in critical need of modernization. This project is in the planning phase using the Omnia contract. Design/Build Contractor: ThyssenKrupp (Omni Contract) Scope: $440,000 Fund Source: 2024-2026 AP Funds (100%) Anticipated Completion: Summer 2027

address_quote: University Center 142 Nunn Drive Highland Heights, KY 41099
